purpose.objective: Test whether PIT-safe Brent information has reproducible lead-lag association with subsequent USDRUBF close returns before any regime segmentation or trading-rule design.

methodology.quantile_effect: mean forward return in highest feature quintile minus lowest feature quintile
methodology.temporal_stability: chronological early/middle/late thirds on each pair's valid rows
methodology.bootstrap: circular moving-block bootstrap on each pair's valid chronological rows
methodology.robust_pair_rule: Spearman block-bootstrap CI excludes zero AND quintile-spread block-bootstrap CI excludes zero AND signs are coherent AND all 3 chronological thirds have the overall Spearman sign
methodology.suggestive_pair_rule: at least one of the two block-bootstrap CIs excludes zero AND signs are coherent AND at least 2 of 3 chronological thirds have the overall Spearman sign
methodology.h1_rule: robust if any primary impulse pair is robust; suggestive if none robust and at least one primary pair suggestive; otherwise not supported
methodology.h2_rule: for each primary impulse feature compare +1 session absolute Spearman with the strongest +3/+5/+10 session pair; delayed strengthening requires later-minus-1session absolute Spearman >= 0.03 and the later pair robust/suggestive
methodology.multiple_testing_boundary: exploratory descriptive research; pair evidence is not a causal claim or trading significance test

gates.G1_upstream_readiness: accepted Phase 02B brent_only dataset G9 PASS
gates.G2_identity_and_schema: exact 472 aligned identities, exact seven feature and four label columns, exact 28 pairs
gates.G3_pair_coverage: every pair has at least 300 finite observations after structural nulls
gates.G4_descriptive_metrics: all required pairwise, quantile and temporal metrics finite
gates.G6_quantile_effects: exact 28 pair rows with top-minus-bottom quintile effect
gates.G7_temporal_stability: exact 28 pair rows and at least 90 observations in each chronological third
gates.G8_scope_and_leakage: no network, source mutation, model fit, threshold optimization, trading-rule design, broker or trading action

authority_boundary.runtime_scope: one brent_only Phase 03 research materialization from the accepted Phase 02B dataset
